dcterms:description: Spherical MNIST is constructed from the MNIST dataset by backprojecting the digits into equirectangular projection. The digit labels are used to train the source CNN (recognition model), but they are not used to train the KTN. Classiﬁcation accuracy on the 360◦-iﬁed test set is used as the evaluation metric.
dcterms:title: Spherical MNIST

dcterms:description: Pano2Vid is a real world 360◦ video dataset containing 86 videos from four categories: 'Hiking,' 'Parade,' 'Soccer,' and 'Mountain Climbing.' The models are trained to reproduce the convolution outputs of the source model, so no labels are required for training. The root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the final convolution outputs is used as the evaluation metric.
dcterms:title: Pano2Vid

dcterms:description: Pascal VOC is a perspective image dataset with object annotations. The object bounding boxes are backprojected to equirectangular projection. This dataset is used for evaluation only, and the accuracy of the detector network in Faster R-CNN on the validation set is used as the evaluation metric.
dcterms:title: Pascal VOC
